newsitem.title: FRANCE: French sex drive wanes, survey says.
newsitem.headline: French sex drive wanes, survey says.

text.p: The fabled French sex drive is waning and over half of the French queried for a new survey on their private lives say they can put up with long periods of chastity.
A survey for the magazine L'Evenement du Jeudi released on Wednesday showed 38 percent of those polled were making love less than they used to and 42 percent said their sex lives were unchanged.
Nine percent said they had more sex "than before" -- a time period the survey did not explain.
Forty-nine percent said they often or sometimes had no desire to make love while 45 percent swore their amorous interest rarely if ever flagged.
As for chastity, 52 percent said they would not be bothered by a long period without making love. Another 43 percent, though, were sure they would be.
A closer look at the statistics showed that men were more aware than women, by a margin of 39 to 37 percent, of making love less than they used to.

The idea of long periods of sexual abstention bothered men more than women by a margin of 56 to 31 percent. Forty-four percent of men in the survey admitted to a flagging sex drive compared to 53 percent of the women.
The survey, conducted on August 7 on a sample of 960 people aged 18 or over, gave no reasons for the trends.
